method: view_image of actual on-disk original and proportional 360/680 PNGs, each at original detail; direct visual inspection, not metadata alone
observedFindings: The bacterial side contains free DNA and an operator-bound repressor; it contains no histone spools.
The eukaryotic side contains two nucleosome symbols, an accessible region and a differently shaped activator.
The comparison mark and labels stay readable at 360 and 680 widths; no output or transformation arrow equates the models.
limitations: The pale polymerase symbol is an orientation cue, not a complete initiation mechanism.
Equal measured outputs would not establish equal mechanisms; the full two material cases remain necessary.
altTextDe: Zwei getrennte Modellkarten zeigen bakterielle DNA mit gebundenem Repressor und eukaryotische DNA um Histone mit Aktivator. Ein Fragezeichen lädt zum Vergleich der Mechanismen ein.
altTextEn: Separate model cards show bacterial DNA with a bound repressor and eukaryotic DNA around histones with an activator. A question mark invites comparison of the mechanisms.
